# Heptabase — Style Reference

> Graphite ink on fog paper, with one highlighter left uncapped. Instrument Sans display over Inter text, a #f7f7f7 canvas, 8%-black hairline rings, and a single citation blue rationed to page references inside reading cards.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Heptabase speaks an annotated-manuscript product language: the marketing chrome is a study desk, and the product mockups carry the ink. The canvas is Fog Canvas #f7f7f7, white Paper White #ffffff cards sit on top with 146 background uses, and Ash Tile #eeeded supplies both the secondary fill and the 3px card rule. The chromatic budget for chrome is zero. The primary action is Graphite Ink #2e2e2e, not a brand hue, and the only system color is Signal Blue #207dff, which appears 256 times almost entirely as page-citation text. Every other saturated hue is a 50%-alpha highlighter mark inside the reading cards. Typography splits the work: Instrument Sans at weight 500 with tight negative tracking carries 36px and 48px headlines in a Perfect Fourth step, while Inter at 400 and 600 handles everything from 11px to 32px with zero tracking. Shapes are soft, with 2px to 12px corners and a 9999px pill reserved for the nav CTA. Elevation comes from 8%-black inset hairlines. The whole reads as a scholar's working notebook rather than a SaaS landing page.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fog Canvas | `#f7f7f7` | `--color-fog-canvas` | Body background, the sticky nav backdrop and the gutters around showcase frames — a near-white grey that lets #ffffff cards register without needing a single drop shadow. |
| Paper White | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-white` | Reading cards, footer, app windows and the active toggle segment, with 146 background uses — the elevated sheet of paper that every piece of content sits on. |
| Ash Tile | `#eeeded` | `--color-ash-tile` | 3px card rules (78 uses), inline tag tokens, active tree rows and the toggle track — a single warm-grey that serves as both fill and frame. |
| Graphite Ink | `#2e2e2e` | `--color-graphite-ink` | Body text (1,844 uses), headlines, the logo mark and both CTA fills — a softened black that keeps 48px headlines from shouting. It is the action color, by design. |
| Slate Caption | `#000000b8` | `--color-slate-caption` | Hero subhead, section descriptions and secondary nav copy at 72% black — translucent rather than a fixed grey, so it tints correctly on #f7f7f7 and #ffffff alike. |
| Mist Hint | `#00000052` | `--color-mist-hint` | Tree-row counts, "Knowledge" group labels and placeholder copy at 32% black, with 83 uses — the quietest legible text and the bottom of the hierarchy. |
| Dove Hairline | `#00000014` | `--color-dove-hairline` | Footer top border, input frames and inset ring shadows at 8% black — the system's only line weight for structure. Do not darken it past 14% black. |
| Signal Blue | `#207dff` | `--color-signal-blue` | Page citations like "pp. 3–11", inline links and the selection ring, 256 uses — the one rationed system hue. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Sand Tag | `#b5801a` | `--color-sand-tag` | The "#" glyph on inline tag tokens and amber annotation text, 57 uses — a muted ochre that marks taxonomy rather than action. Keep it off buttons. |
| Forest Mark | `#0f8f40` | `--color-forest-mark` | Green annotation text and confirmation labels inside product mockups, 40 uses — decorative-only reading ink. It does not appear in marketing chrome. |
| Sunbeam Marker | `#e8bd3b80` | `--color-sunbeam-marker` | Yellow highlight blocks behind claims inside reading cards, 19 uses at 50% alpha — the signature annotation tint. It belongs inside mockups and nowhere else. |
| Sprout Marker | `#31d86980` | `--color-sprout-marker` | Green highlight runs and progress fills inside mockups, 33 uses, the most frequent chromatic fill — decorative-only, so the color budget stays inside the product. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Instrument Sans — the headline voice, medium weight and tightly tracked · `--font-instrument-sans`
- **Substitute:** Instrument Sans at 500 (free on Google Fonts, the original face), Inter Tight at 500, Geist at 500. Instrument Sans 500 draws close to its nominal weight, so match 500 to 500 and do not drop to 400, which reads visibly thinner at 48px.
- **Weights:** 500
- **Sizes:** 36px, 48px
- **Line height:** 1.15, 1.3
- **Letter spacing:** -0.54px at 36px (-0.015em), -1.58px at 48px (-0.033em)
- **Role:** Medium weight at display sizes is deliberate. Headlines are confident without the 700 bold that landing-page convention reaches for. The 36→48 step is a clean Perfect Fourth at 1.333, and the tracking doubles in em terms at the top size, so the 48px hero tightens into a single printed line. Pairing a grotesk headline face with Inter body separates "the argument" from "the apparatus".

### Inter — the workhorse for UI, body and reading cards · `--font-inter`
- **Substitute:** Inter at 400/600 (the original, free), Geist at 400/600, IBM Plex Sans at 450/600. Plex draws slightly lighter than Inter at 400, so lift it to 450 to match stroke thickness.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 11px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 16px, 17px, 18px, 25.5px, 32px
- **Line height:** 1.25, 1.3, 1.36, 1.43, 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at all sizes except -0.36px at 18px on the wordmark
- **Role:** Inter covers 2,171 element uses, which makes it the page's fabric. Weight 600 (364 uses) does the hierarchy work inside cards, while 500 is reserved for interactive labels like "Get started". Inside the reading cards the scale steps on a 1.5 ratio (17→25.5px), far steeper than the Minor Third 1.2 convention, because those cards mimic document outlines where headings must separate at a glance.

### Georgia — the title-page serif, tracked into small capitals · `--font-georgia`
- **Substitute:** EB Garamond at 500, Libre Baskerville at 400, Cormorant Garamond at 500. EB Garamond at 400 draws lighter than Georgia, so take it to 500. Libre Baskerville draws heavier, so keep it at 400.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 13px, 15px
- **Line height:** 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 3.25px at 13px (0.25em), 3px at 15px (0.2em)
- **Role:** Georgia appears only 11 times, on book title pages such as "AN ENQUIRY concerning HUMAN UNDERSTANDING" inside the PDF viewer. Wide 0.2–0.25em tracking turns it into an engraved micro-label. It is a prop that signals "real books live here" and is never used for marketing copy.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 400 | 11px | 1.36 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 400 | 12px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | 400 | 14px | 1.43 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 400 | 18px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Inter | 600 | 18px | 1.5 | -0.36px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Inter | 600 | 25.5px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Inter | 600 | 32px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Instrument Sans | 500 | 36px | 1.15 | -0.54px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Instrument Sans | 500 | 48px | 1.3 | -1.58px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Fill the primary action with Graphite Ink #2e2e2e and white 16px Inter 600 text — the chrome stays colorless, and that is what lets the reading-card highlights carry the page.
- Set headlines in Instrument Sans 500 at 48px with -1.58px tracking and 36px with -0.54px — medium weight plus tight tracking gives authority without the shouting of a 700 bold.
- Frame content cards with a 3px #eeeded border at 12px radius on #ffffff — the thick tonal rule replaces shadow, and its 3px weight is non-negotiable for card identity.
- Draw structural lines as `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)` inset rings or 1px #00000014 borders — translucent black at 8% sits correctly on both #f7f7f7 and #ffffff.
- Confine saturated hues to 50%-alpha markers such as #e8bd3b80 with 3px radius behind 17px body text — color must behave like a highlighter pen on a printed page.
- Reserve Signal Blue #207dff for citations and inline links at text weight 400 — a single blue meaning "source" keeps provenance legible across 256 occurrences.
- Separate sections by 128px and cap the content frame at 1396px — the generous rhythm gives each painted showcase room to hang like a framed canvas.

### Don't
- Don't recolor the hero CTA in #207dff because "buttons should be blue" — that conventional move collapses the system's thesis that color belongs to annotation, never to chrome.
- Don't bold headlines to Instrument Sans 700 or set them at 0px tracking — the 500 weight and -0.033em tracking at 48px are the voice, and heavier type turns the hero into a generic launch page.
- Don't add `0 4px 12px` drop shadows to reading cards — depth is reserved for `--shadow-lg` floating windows, and shadowed cards would flatten that one deliberate depth contrast.
- Don't thin the card frame to 1px #eeeded — at 1px, #eeeded on #ffffff disappears, and the card loses its index-card mount.
- Don't round the showcase frame to 12px or 24px — the 0px edge on the 1300×850px painting is what separates artwork from interface.
- Don't spread the 9999px pill radius onto the 48px hero CTA — the pill belongs to the 36px nav button and the toggle, while the hero slab keeps its 10px corners.
- Don't use opaque highlight colors such as fully solid yellow behind text — at 100% alpha the #2e2e2e ink loses contrast, and the marker stops reading as transparent ink.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #f7f7f7 (Fog Canvas)
- card surface: #ffffff (Paper White)
- card frame and tag fill: #eeeded (Ash Tile)
- primary text: #2e2e2e (Graphite Ink)
- secondary text: #000000b8 (Slate Caption)
- hairline: #00000014 (Dove Hairline)
- citation link: #207dff (Signal Blue)
- primary action: #2e2e2e (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Charts and bars use the highlighter set as 50%-alpha fills (#31d86980, #e8bd3b80) or Signal Blue tinted to 12% opacity behind #2e2e2e labels, so data reads as annotation and the graphite CTA stays the heaviest mark on the page.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor element with background #2e2e2e, text color #ffffff, no border, border-radius 10px, padding 14px 24px, height 48px, font Inter at 16px weight 600 with line-height 20px and 0px letter-spacing, and box-shadow `rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.1) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.1) 0px 2px 4px 0px`. Label it "Start your 7-day trial". On hover keep the fill at #2e2e2e and raise the shadow to `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 0px 8px 20px 0px`. Do not use any blue.

2. Build a Navigation Bar: a sticky header, 72px tall, background #f7f7f7, no border or shadow, inner container max-width 1396px with 48px side padding. Left: a 28px #2e2e2e logo mark and the wordmark "Heptabase" in Inter 18px weight 600, letter-spacing -0.36px, 8px gap. Center: ghost links "Resources" (with a 12px chevron), "Download" and "Pricing", each transparent with #2e2e2e text, Inter 16px weight 400, padding 8px 12px, border-radius 8px, hover background #eeeded. Right: "Log in" as a ghost link and "Get started" as a pill with background #2e2e2e, text #ffffff, Inter 16px weight 500, padding 8px 16px, border-radius 9999px, height 36px, 8px gap between them.

3. Build a Hero Section: background #f7f7f7, centered column, 80px top padding. First a segmented toggle with a #eeeded track, 9999px radius, 4px padding, an active "App" segment in #ffffff with `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) 0px 0px 0px 1px inset` and an inactive "Plugin" label in #00000052, both Inter 12px weight 500 with 4px 16px padding. Then 32px below, a two-line h1 in Instrument Sans 48px weight 500, line-height 1.3, letter-spacing -1.58px, color #2e2e2e. Then 24px below, an 18px Inter weight 400 subhead, line-height 1.5, color #000000b8, max-width 520px. Then 32px below, the graphite primary button. Then 48px below, a 1300px-wide painted image frame with 0px radius holding a #ffffff app window with 12px radius and `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 0px 12px 28px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) 0px 2px 6px 0px`.

4. Build an Annotated Reading Card: a div with background #ffffff, border 3px solid #eeeded, border-radius 12px, 12px inner padding, width 300px. Title in Inter 17px weight 600, line-height 1.5, color #2e2e2e. Body bullets in Inter 14px weight 400, line-height 1.43, color #2e2e2e, 8px gap. Wrap one claim in a span with background #e8bd3b80, border-radius 3px, padding 3px 2px. End each bullet with a citation "pp. 20–24" in #207dff at the same size, weight 400, no underline, border-radius 2px. Place four cards in a row with a 12px gap and no shadows.

### Primary CTA Button — Graphite Block

### Pill Button — Graphite (Nav CTA)
**Role:** Persistent sign-up entry in the nav

Compact rounded capsule. Background #2e2e2e, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 9999px, padding 8px 16px, height 36px, Inter at 16px weight 500, no shadow — this is the system outlier, the only 9999px action on a page whose corners otherwise top out at 12px. ### Ghost Nav Button (Secondary)
**Role:** Navigation links and the secondary action

Borderless text target. Transparent background, text #2e2e2e, no border, border-radius 8px, padding 8px 12px, height 36px, Inter at 16px weight 400, no shadow, with hover filling to Ash Tile #eeeded — the secondary action is a link that becomes a button only under the cursor. "Log in", "Download" and "Pricing" therefore weigh nothing until you reach for them.

### Navigation Bar
**Role:** Sticky top chrome, three zones

Thin sticky strip. Background #f7f7f7, height 72px, position sticky, no bottom shadow at rest; on the left a 28px Graphite Ink logo mark beside an 18px Inter wordmark at weight 600 with -0.36px tracking, centered ghost links with a chevron on "Resources", and "Log in" plus the graphite pill on the right with 8px gaps — the bar shares the canvas color, so it reads as the top margin of the page rather than a header slab.

### Segmented Toggle — App / Plugin
**Role:** Switches the hero product context

Small pill switch, estimated. Track #eeeded with border-radius 9999px and 4px inner padding, active segment #ffffff with `--shadow-subtle` ring and 9999px radius, inactive label #00000052 next to a 6px grey dot, padding 4px 16px, Inter at 12px weight 500, height about 28px — it borrows the nav pill's radius on purpose, so the two capsule shapes form one family above the fold.

### Reading Card — Main Content Card
**Role:** Holds outlines, notes and annotated text

Framed white sheet. Background #ffffff, text #2e2e2e, border 3px solid #eeeded, border-radius 12px, padding 0px with content inset 12px, Inter at 16px weight 400 and 600 headings at 17px, no shadow — the 3px tonal rule is the signature. Convention would draw a 1px grey border plus a drop shadow; here the frame is thick and the same color as the fills, so the card reads like a mounted index card rather than a floating panel.

### Floating App Window
**Role:** Product chrome inside the showcase

Raised desktop window. Background #ffffff, border-radius 12px, shadow `--shadow-lg`, a 1px ring plus a 12px/28px drop, toolbar row with Inter at 14px weight 400 breadcrumbs in #2e2e2e and #00000052 separators, a 36px left tool rail in #ffffff with `--shadow-subtle` — this is the only place real depth appears, so it marks the boundary between the marketing page and the product it frames.

### Showcase Stage — Painted Backdrop
**Role:** Full-width frame for product demos

Square-cornered painting. Image 1300×850px, border-radius 0px, no border, no shadow, filled with an oil-painted landscape (dusk clouds, starry meadow) behind floating windows inset roughly 48px from the frame edges, plus a 24px circular pause control at bottom right — the hard 0px edge is deliberate. It makes each demo read as a canvas hung on the wall rather than a rounded UI card.

### Highlighter Mark
**Role:** Color-coded annotation inside cards

Translucent marker swipe. Background #e8bd3b80 or #31d86980, text #2e2e2e, no border, border-radius 3px, padding 3px 2px, Inter at 17px weight 400 — the 50% alpha lets the graphite text show through exactly as on a printed page. It is the only sanctioned way for saturated color to enter content, which makes it punctuation rather than decoration.

### Citation Link
**Role:** Page reference back to the source

Inline blue reference. Transparent background, text #207dff, no underline, border-radius 2px for its focus state, padding 0px, Inter at 17px weight 400, examples "pp. 3–11" and "p. 16" — Signal Blue is rationed to provenance, so blue means "this came from a page" and nothing else.

### Inline Tag Token
**Role:** Names a product feature in headlines

Grey chip inside a headline. Background #eeeded, glyph "#" in #b5801a, label #2e2e2e at the host heading's size, border-radius 6px, padding 2px 6px, estimated, no border, no shadow — "Forge your worldview with nested # Databases." embeds the product's own tag syntax in marketing type. It is the headline equivalent of the highlighter: a product object spliced into prose.

### Feature Tile — Essentials Row
**Role:** Five-up grid of core features

Small white tile. Background #ffffff, border-radius 12px, shadow `--shadow-subtle` ring, padding 16px, label at 16px Inter weight 500 (measured 450 inside a scaled mockup, snapped) with 4px bottom padding, 228px wide in a five-column row with 12px gaps, under the 36px Instrument Sans heading "All the essentials, done right." — these tiles are deliberately understated. They list utilities rather than sell them.

### Footer
**Role:** Sitemap and legal closure

Flat white slab. Background #ffffff, border-top 1px solid #00000014, border-radius 0px, height 523px, multi-column link lists in Inter at 14px weight 400 with column titles at 14px weight 600, gaps of 8px between links and 48px between columns — the switch from #f7f7f7 to #ffffff at the page bottom is the only full-width surface change, so the footer reads as the back cover.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Fill the primary action with Graphite Ink #2e2e2e and white 16px Inter 600 text — the chrome stays colorless, and that is what lets the reading-card highlights carry the page.
- Set headlines in Instrument Sans 500 at 48px with -1.58px tracking and 36px with -0.54px — medium weight plus tight tracking gives authority without the shouting of a 700 bold.
- Frame content cards with a 3px #eeeded border at 12px radius on #ffffff — the thick tonal rule replaces shadow, and its 3px weight is non-negotiable for card identity.
- Draw structural lines as `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)` inset rings or 1px #00000014 borders — translucent black at 8% sits correctly on both #f7f7f7 and #ffffff.
- Confine saturated hues to 50%-alpha markers such as #e8bd3b80 with 3px radius behind 17px body text — color must behave like a highlighter pen on a printed page.
- Reserve Signal Blue #207dff for citations and inline links at text weight 400 — a single blue meaning "source" keeps provenance legible across 256 occurrences.
- Separate sections by 128px and cap the content frame at 1396px — the generous rhythm gives each painted showcase room to hang like a framed canvas.

### Don't
- Don't recolor the hero CTA in #207dff because "buttons should be blue" — that conventional move collapses the system's thesis that color belongs to annotation, never to chrome.
- Don't bold headlines to Instrument Sans 700 or set them at 0px tracking — the 500 weight and -0.033em tracking at 48px are the voice, and heavier type turns the hero into a generic launch page.
- Don't add `0 4px 12px` drop shadows to reading cards — depth is reserved for `--shadow-lg` floating windows, and shadowed cards would flatten that one deliberate depth contrast.
- Don't thin the card frame to 1px #eeeded — at 1px, #eeeded on #ffffff disappears, and the card loses its index-card mount.
- Don't round the showcase frame to 12px or 24px — the 0px edge on the 1300×850px painting is what separates artwork from interface.
- Don't spread the 9999px pill radius onto the 48px hero CTA — the pill belongs to the 36px nav button and the toggle, while the hero slab keeps its 10px corners.
- Don't use opaque highlight colors such as fully solid yellow behind text — at 100% alpha the #2e2e2e ink loses contrast, and the marker stops reading as transparent ink.

## Imagery

The page uses no photography and no stock illustration. Imagery is product screenshots and live mockups laid over oil-painted landscapes: dusk cloudbanks and a starry meadow, each cropped to a hard-edged 1300×850px frame with 0px radius, no border and no shadow. Inside, app windows float with 12px corners and the `--shadow-lg` stack, and the mockups carry their own content: Hume's Enquiry rendered as reading cards, a Georgia title page, and a dark video player with a glowing river map whose amber lines are mockup-internal and not system tokens. Icons are 1.5px-stroke monoline glyphs at roughly 16px in #2e2e2e, used for tool rails and file badges. There are no gradient orbs or glows in the chrome, and the painted skies are decorative assets rather than system tokens. The narrative is the scholar's studio: classic texts on the desk, a painting on the wall.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1396px container that frames 1300px-wide media, with hero text narrowed to a 520px subhead column and 900–960px headline measures. Sections fall on a 128px rhythm. The hero is centered: segmented toggle, two-line 48px Instrument Sans headline, 18px subhead in #000000b8, graphite CTA, then a full-width painted showcase. Below the hero, sections alternate a left-aligned 36px headline with an inline tag token and a showcase stage, closing with a centered headline over a five-column feature-tile row. There is no pricing grid or logo wall on this page, though investor marks appear inline. The nav is sticky, 72px, filled with #f7f7f7, logo left, links centered, "Log in" and the pill right. The footer is a 523px white slab with multi-column links. At 375px, drop display to 36px, use heading-lg tokens for 32px section heads, and cut section gaps to 80px. Overall density: comfortable.

## Annotation Color Discipline

The discipline is that saturated color only exists as a reader's mark. Signal Blue #207dff means "cited page", and the 50%-alpha markers #e8bd3b80 and #31d86980 mean "I noticed this". Everything a visitor clicks to buy is graphite. The system breaks the moment a marketer paints a section background in Sunbeam Marker, adds a blue gradient to the hero, or gives feature tiles colored icons, because color then starts selling instead of annotating. To extend the system, add new hues only as translucent marks at 50% alpha with 3px corners behind #2e2e2e text, inside a #ffffff card. A new category gets a new marker tint, not a new button color. Status messages follow the same rule as tinted inline text, not filled banners.

## Tonal Frame Logic

Structure here is drawn with tone and translucency rather than shadow. Cards are framed by a 3px #eeeded rule, dividers are 8%-black inset hairlines, and the nav shares the #f7f7f7 canvas instead of floating above it. Real depth, the 12px/28px drop at 16% black, is spent only on product windows hovering over painted skies. Applying medium shadows to cards, tiles or the nav destroys that single depth contrast and makes the marketing chrome compete with the product. To extend the system, give new containers either the 3px #eeeded frame (content you read) or the `--shadow-subtle` ring (utilities you scan), and keep `--shadow-lg` exclusive to anything that represents an actual application window.

## Similar Brands

- **Heptabase** — Shares Notion's graphite-black primary button and colorless chrome on an off-white canvas, but swaps Notion's flat page metaphor for framed 12px cards with a 3px tonal rule.
- **Heptabase** — Shares Muse's spatial card canvas for thinking, rendered here as white cards on #f7f7f7 rather than Muse's darker board surfaces.
- **Heptabase** — Shares Readwise's highlighter-yellow annotation as the emotional color of the product, though Heptabase keeps that yellow at 50% alpha and strictly inside mockups.
- **Heptabase** — Shares Obsidian's knowledge-graph audience and bi-directional link vocabulary, but presents it in a light, paper-toned scheme instead of Obsidian's dark violet default.
- **Heptabase** — Shares Linear's tight negative tracking on medium-weight display type, applied at -0.033em on 48px Instrument Sans rather than Linear's dark-canvas Inter Display.
